conventions.annualization: 365 calendar days; sample daily standard deviation; risk-free rate zero
conventions.execution: one-minute bar open assigned to the opening boundary; exact first trade time unknown
conventions.fill_reference_ids: bar:<symbol>:<market>:<open_ns>; source-bar references, not individual trade IDs
conventions.hashes: SHA-256; manifest excluded from output_hashes and checked by sidecar
conventions.leg_delay: configured delay 1 second; fill at a strictly later available minute open, typically up to one additional minute per leg
conventions.liquidation_path: no intrabar high/low path; risk uses the last available closed one-minute mark
conventions.marks: last available closed one-minute mark for risk and valuation
conventions.participation: prior closed one-minute volume; approximation of rolling 60 seconds; unavailable before bar close
conventions.slippage: included in fill; informational attribution never subtracted twice
conventions.synthetic: software validation only; never historical academic results
conventions.terminal_positions: valued without forced close or hypothetical fees

observed_range.source: backtest clock; market-data coverage is in data_coverage.csv
